entities.name: Walter T. Colquitt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Walter Terry Colquitt was a lawyer, circuit-riding Methodist preacher, slave owner, and politician. Born in Virginia, he later moved with his family to Georgia, where he grew up. He graduated from Princeton College, "read the law", and passed the bar.
